fee_notes: Base fee $70,000 uniformly imposed. 10% discount to veteran-majority-owned franchisees reduces to $63,000. Additional required initial fees: Training $7,500, Territory $15,000–$50,000 (by territory population), Technology $12,500.
raw_excerpt: Upon your execution of the Franchise Agreement, you must pay to CITY WIDE the initial franchise fee ("Initial Franchise Fee") of $70,000 for the right to operate one CITY WIDE franchise... CITY WIDE offers a ten percent (10%) discount off the Initial Franchise Fee if you are majority-owned by a veteran.
